qualification: Inherited hematite-bearing illite grain coating; stock remains in the dry-solid mode. The v2 realization uses a finite particulate shell in v3.2c. Old saved v1 IDs retain bulk optics. Geological eligibility and bleaching limitations are unchanged. Conditional morphology, not a measured formation match.

hematite_mass_fraction.interval_kind: literature-informed scenario support, not measured formation range
hematite_mass_fraction.conditions: quartz-rich arid oxidizing continental deposition; early diagenesis; no later bleaching; Fe is allocated within the closed mode
hematite_mass_fraction.reference: UGS-2020; NPS-Navajo; other host fractions remain v3.1 project priors

aridity_max.conditions: entire recorded deposition interval; oxidation must be independently recorded

maximum_supported_burial_m.conditions: grade zero; deeper diagenetic transformations unsupported

coating_illite_mass_fraction.interval_kind: partition sensitivity support, not formation measurement
coating_illite_mass_fraction.conditions: All inherited illite assigned to the conformal grain rim in the central scenario; no added mass. Clay matrix for iron-oxide coatings is supported qualitatively, partition not measured.

literature.colour: red, brown, pink, salmon, gold, white

literature.colour: reddish orange; many cliff faces carry desert varnish
literature.conditions: Qualitative appearance, not numeric reflectance or Lab.

colour_validation.method: CIE tabulated 1931 2deg and D65 for USGS; RIT renotation C with Bradford C->D65 for Munsell. See lane evidence/standards.json and report; no universal single formation standard.
colour_validation.reason: Per-standard errors are measured in lane report; quantitative formation equivalence remains unqualified.
